svg.text: Power rails unused (top and bottom) so a split rail cannot bite
QT cable 4209; Dupont ends into cols 1-4, row g
component side up; the green LED must light
6 male-female jumpers, female end on the pin
SW1 across the gap, legs in columns 20 and 22
Smart dumbbell - half-size breadboard wiring (one button, Nano off-board)

2026-11-06. No power rails; the four nets each take one column as a hub: col 1 = 3V3, col 2 = GND, col 3 = SDA, col 4 = SCL (rows f-j). Column 2 of the lower half is GND too (jumper 19 bridges it). Plug the Nano's six wires first, then the modules.
No buzzer (firmware USE_BUZZER 0). D3, D4, D5 free. All logic 3.3 V; the Nano is powered only over USB-C.
Jumper list (1-6 male-female, the rest male-male)
Nano GND (left row, pin 14, next to VIN)
GND bridge to the lower half col 2 j
SW1 tact switch across the gap, four legs in columns 20 and 22, rows e and f; pressing connects column 20 to 22.
R1 220 ohm: col 26 b to col 28 b. LED long leg col 28 c, short leg col 29 c.
OLED and MAX30102 boards hang over the top edge, pins in row j.
4517 lies beside the board, component side up; power is present only when its green LED is on.
The 5 holes of a column are connected; upper and lower halves are separate. Column 2, upper half, uses all 5.
After wiring run bus_check first: all four addresses must report rc=0.
